title: mfs_payments_db - Database Schema Documentation
text: mfs_payments_db Schema Documentation. Connection Details. Host: pghost-prod-01.mfs.internal. Port: 5432. Read replica: pghost-prod-01-ro.mfs.internal. Service account: svc-payment-api. Schema version: v2026.09.15. Migration tool: Alembic. Total estimated rows: 142M. Used by: mfs-payment-gateway (mfs-pay-pod-01). Table: payments. Primary table for all payment records. Columns: payment_id (UUID, PK), customer_id (UUID, NOT NULL, FK to mfs_customers_db.customers), amount (BIGINT, NOT NULL, stored in minor units), currency (VARCHAR(3), NOT NULL, FK to currencies), card_token (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL, references Token Vault), status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, default 'pending'), description (TEXT), idempotency_key (VARCHAR(128), UNIQUE), fraud_score (NUMERIC(5,4)), processor_response (JSONB), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()), updated_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL). Row count: ~68M. Partitioned by created_at (monthly). Retention: indefinite. Table: transactions. Individual transaction events within a payment lifecycle. Columns: txn_id (UUID, PK), payment_id (UUID, NOT NULL, FK to payments), type (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: authorization, capture, refund, chargeback, void), amount (BIGINT, NOT NULL), status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL), processor_response (JSONB), processor_txn_id (VARCHAR(128)), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()). Row count: ~52M. One payment may have multiple transactions (authorize, capture, partial refund, etc.). Table: currencies. Supported currency reference table. Columns: currency_code (VARCHAR(3), PK), name (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL), decimal_places (INTEGER, NOT NULL), active (BOOLEAN, NOT NULL, default true). Row count: 6 (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, JPY). Table: settlements. Batch settlement records. Columns: settlement_id (UUID, PK), batch_date (DATE, NOT NULL), total_amount (BIGINT, NOT NULL), transaction_count (INTEGER, NOT NULL), currency (VARCHAR(3), NOT NULL, FK to currencies), status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL), processor_id (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL), processor_response (JSONB), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL), settled_at (TIMESTAMPTZ), reconciled_at (TIMESTAMPTZ). Row count: ~12K. One batch per day per currency per processor. Table: audit_log. Payment-level audit trail. Columns: log_id (BIGSERIAL, PK), payment_id (UUID, NOT NULL, FK to payments), action (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL), actor (VARCHAR(128), NOT NULL, typically a service account like svc-payment-api), details (JSONB), ip_address (INET), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()). Row count: ~22M. Retention: 7 years (PCI DSS requirement). Indexes. payments_customer_id_idx ON payments(customer_id). payments_status_created_idx ON payments(status, created_at). payments_idempotency_key_uniq ON payments(idempotency_key) UNIQUE. transactions_payment_id_idx ON transactions(payment_id). transactions_type_created_idx ON transactions(type, created_at). settlements_batch_date_idx ON settlements(batch_date). audit_log_payment_id_idx ON audit_log(payment_id). audit_log_created_at_idx ON audit_log(created_at). Foreign Keys. payments.currency -> currencies.currency_code. transactions.payment_id -> payments.payment_id. settlements.currency -> currencies.currency_code. audit_log.payment_id -> payments.payment_id.

title: mfs_fraud_db - Database Schema Documentation
text: mfs_fraud_db Schema Documentation. Connection Details. Host: pghost-prod-02.mfs.internal. Port: 5432. Read replica: pghost-prod-02-ro.mfs.internal. Service account: svc-fraud-engine. Schema version: v2026.09.20. Migration tool: Alembic. Total estimated rows: 88M. Used by: mfs-fraud-engine (mfs-fraud-pod-01). Table: fraud_scores. Fraud scoring results for every evaluated transaction. Columns: score_id (UUID, PK), txn_id (UUID, NOT NULL, UNIQUE), ml_score (NUMERIC(5,4), NOT NULL, range 0.0000-1.0000), rule_score (NUMERIC(5,4), NOT NULL), final_score (NUMERIC(5,4), NOT NULL), risk_level (VARCHAR(16), NOT NULL, one of: low, medium, high, critical), model_version (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL, e.g. 'fraud-xgb-v4.2'), signals (JSONB, array of signal objects), latency_ms (INTEGER), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()). Row count: ~68M. Partitioned by created_at (monthly). Score published to fraud-scores Kafka topic on kafka-broker.mfs.internal. Table: velocity_windows. Sliding window aggregates for velocity-based fraud detection. Columns: window_id (UUID, PK), customer_id (UUID, NOT NULL), window_type (VARCHAR(16), NOT NULL, one of: 1min, 5min, 1hour, 24hour), count (INTEGER, NOT NULL, default 0), sum_amount (BIGINT, NOT NULL, default 0), window_start (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL), window_end (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL). Row count: ~8M active windows. Managed by VelocityMonitor in engine/velocity.py. Real-time windows are cached in redis-cluster.mfs.internal and persisted to this table periodically. Table: aml_alerts. Anti-money laundering alerts generated by the AML rule engine. Columns: alert_id (UUID, PK), txn_id (UUID, NOT NULL), customer_id (UUID, NOT NULL), rule_id (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, e.g. STRUCT-001, RAPID-001, GEO-001, MERCH-001), severity (VARCHAR(16), NOT NULL, one of: low, medium, high, critical), status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, default 'open', one of: open, under_review, cleared, escalated), analyst_notes (TEXT), reviewer_id (VARCHAR(128)), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()), reviewed_at (TIMESTAMPTZ). Row count: ~45K. Published to aml-alerts Kafka topic. Table: models. ML model metadata and versioning. Columns: model_id (UUID, PK), name (VARCHAR(128), NOT NULL), version (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL, UNIQUE), algorithm (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL), f1_score (NUMERIC(5,4)), precision_score (NUMERIC(5,4)), recall_score (NUMERIC(5,4)), auc_roc (NUMERIC(5,4)), training_data_rows (BIGINT), deployed_at (TIMESTAMPTZ), status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: training, staging, production, canary, retired), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL). Row count: ~25. Current production: fraud-xgb-v4.2 (F1=0.9612, deployed 2026-09-20). Canary: fraud-xgb-v4.3 (F1=0.9654, 5% traffic, deployed 2026-09-28). Artifacts stored in MLflow at mlflow.mfs.internal:5000. Table: features. Extracted feature vectors for model training and auditing. Columns: feature_id (UUID, PK), txn_id (UUID, NOT NULL), feature_vector (JSONB, NOT NULL), extraction_time_ms (INTEGER), extractor_version (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL). Row count: ~12M (retained 90 days for retraining). Computed by FeatureExtractor in features/extractor.py. Indexes. fraud_scores_txn_id_uniq ON fraud_scores(txn_id) UNIQUE. fraud_scores_risk_level_created_idx ON fraud_scores(risk_level, created_at). fraud_scores_final_score_idx ON fraud_scores(final_score). velocity_windows_customer_type_idx ON velocity_windows(customer_id, window_type). aml_alerts_status_created_idx ON aml_alerts(status, created_at). aml_alerts_customer_id_idx ON aml_alerts(customer_id). models_version_uniq ON models(version) UNIQUE. models_status_idx ON models(status). features_txn_id_idx ON features(txn_id). Foreign Keys. No cross-database foreign keys. Referential integrity to mfs_payments_db.transactions.txn_id is enforced at the application level in engine/scorer.py.

title: mfs_customers_db - Database Schema Documentation
text: mfs_customers_db Schema Documentation. Connection Details. Host: pghost-prod-04.mfs.internal. Port: 5432. Read replica: pghost-prod-04-ro.mfs.internal. Service account: svc-customer-svc. Schema version: v2026.08.10. Total estimated rows: 24M. Used by: mfs-customer-portal backend. Table: customers. Core customer records. Columns: customer_id (UUID, PK), first_name_enc (BYTEA, NOT NULL, encrypted PII via EncryptionUtil.encrypt_field), last_name_enc (BYTEA, NOT NULL, encrypted PII), email_hash (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL, SHA-256 hash via EncryptionUtil.hash_pii for search), phone_hash (VARCHAR(64), SHA-256 hash), kyc_status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: pending, verified, rejected, expired), tier (VARCHAR(16), default 'standard', one of: standard, premium, platinum), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL), updated_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL). Row count: ~8.2M. PII fields are encrypted at the application level using EncryptionUtil from mfs-common-libs (auth/encryption.py). Table: accounts. Customer financial accounts. Columns: account_id (UUID, PK), customer_id (UUID, NOT NULL, FK to customers), account_type (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: checking, savings, credit, investment), status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: active, suspended, closed), balance_snapshot (BIGINT, minor units, updated nightly), opened_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL), closed_at (TIMESTAMPTZ). Row count: ~12M. Table: cards. Payment cards linked to customer accounts. Columns: card_id (UUID, PK), account_id (UUID, NOT NULL, FK to accounts), token (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL, references Token Vault, no PAN stored), card_type (VARCHAR(16), NOT NULL, one of: debit, credit, prepaid), card_brand (VARCHAR(16), NOT NULL, one of: visa, mastercard, amex, discover), last_four (VARCHAR(4), NOT NULL), expiry_month (INTEGER, NOT NULL), expiry_year (INTEGER, NOT NULL), status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: active, expired, blocked, replaced), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL). Row count: ~3.5M. No raw card numbers are stored. All card data is tokenized via Token Vault API. Table: addresses. Customer address records. Columns: address_id (UUID, PK), customer_id (UUID, NOT NULL, FK to customers), type (VARCHAR(16), NOT NULL, one of: billing, shipping, home, work), line1_enc (BYTEA, NOT NULL, encrypted PII), line2_enc (BYTEA), city (VARCHAR(128), NOT NULL), state (VARCHAR(64)), postal_code (VARCHAR(20), NOT NULL), country (VARCHAR(2), NOT NULL, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Row count: ~5.8M. PII Encryption. PII fields (first_name, last_name, address lines) are encrypted using AES-256-CBC via EncryptionUtil.encrypt_field from mfs-common-libs. Email and phone are stored as SHA-256 hashes via EncryptionUtil.hash_pii for lookup. Decryption requires EncryptionUtil.decrypt_field with keys from vault.mfs.internal. This design satisfies PCI DSS requirement 3.4 for protection of stored cardholder data and CCPA requirements for PII protection. Indexes. customers_email_hash_idx ON customers(email_hash). customers_kyc_status_idx ON customers(kyc_status). accounts_customer_id_idx ON accounts(customer_id). cards_account_id_idx ON cards(account_id). cards_token_idx ON cards(token). addresses_customer_id_idx ON addresses(customer_id).

title: mfs_audit_db - Database Schema Documentation
text: mfs_audit_db Schema Documentation. Connection Details. Host: pghost-prod-03.mfs.internal. Port: 5432. Read replica: pghost-prod-03-ro.mfs.internal. Service account: svc-notification-svc. Schema version: v2026.09.01. Total estimated rows: 310M. Used by: mfs-common-libs (logging/audit.py), all services via AuditLogger. This database is the central audit repository for all Meridian Financial Services applications. All audit writes go through the AuditLogger class in mfs-common-libs. Table: audit_events. General audit events from all services. Columns: event_id (UUID, PK), service_name (VARCHAR(128), NOT NULL, e.g. 'mfs-payment-gateway', 'mfs-fraud-engine'), event_type (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL, e.g. 'payment.created', 'token.created', 'fraud.scored', 'auth.login'), severity (VARCHAR(16), default 'info', one of: debug, info, warning, error, critical), actor (VARCHAR(128), NOT NULL, service account or user identifier), resource_type (VARCHAR(64)), resource_id (VARCHAR(256)), details (JSONB), correlation_id (UUID), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()). Row count: ~180M. Written by AuditLogger.log_event. Partitioned by created_at (monthly). Table: access_logs. Data access audit trail for compliance. Columns: log_id (UUID, PK), service_account (VARCHAR(128), NOT NULL, e.g. 'svc-payment-api', 'svc-fraud-engine'), resource_type (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL, e.g. 'payment', 'customer', 'card_token', 'fraud_score'), resource_id (VARCHAR(256), NOT NULL), action (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: read, write, delete, export), ip_address (INET), user_agent (VARCHAR(256)), success (BOOLEAN, NOT NULL, default true), failure_reason (TEXT), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()). Row count: ~95M. Written by AuditLogger.log_access. Critical for PCI DSS audit trail. Table: change_records. Field-level change tracking for sensitive data. Columns: record_id (UUID, PK), entity_type (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL, e.g. 'customer', 'payment', 'card', 'aml_alert'), entity_id (VARCHAR(256), NOT NULL), field_name (VARCHAR(128), NOT NULL), old_value_hash (VARCHAR(64), SHA-256 hash, NOT NULL), new_value_hash (VARCHAR(64), SHA-256 hash, NOT NULL), changed_by (VARCHAR(128), NOT NULL), change_reason (TEXT), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()). Row count: ~35M. Written by AuditLogger.log_change. Values are stored as hashes to avoid persisting sensitive data in the audit trail. Retention Policy. All audit data is retained for 7 years per PCI DSS requirement 10.7. Partitions older than 7 years are archived to cold storage at backup.mfs.internal and then dropped. Archive verification is performed monthly. Log integrity is maintained via hash chains: each event includes a hash of the previous event's ID and timestamp, making tampering detectable. Indexes. audit_events_service_created_idx ON audit_events(service_name, created_at). audit_events_event_type_idx ON audit_events(event_type). audit_events_actor_idx ON audit_events(actor). audit_events_correlation_idx ON audit_events(correlation_id). access_logs_service_account_idx ON access_logs(service_account). access_logs_resource_type_id_idx ON access_logs(resource_type, resource_id). access_logs_created_at_idx ON access_logs(created_at). change_records_entity_type_id_idx ON change_records(entity_type, entity_id). change_records_created_at_idx ON change_records(created_at).
